ModuleTitle.label: Module Title
ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. It is not displayed to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.label: Module Anchor
ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a direct #anchor link to this section. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionTitle.label: Section Title
SectionTitle.helper: Optional heading displayed above the activity cards. HTML is allowed and will be rendered as entered.

SectionEyebrow.label: Section Eyebrow
SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional short label displayed above the section title. HTML is allowed and will be rendered as entered.

SectionEyebrowColor.label: Section Eyebrow Color
SectionEyebrowColor.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or theme text color with enough contrast against the section background.

SectionDescription.label: Section Description
SectionDescription.helper: Optional supporting text below the title. HTML is allowed and will be rendered as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: A quick view of the work that needs attention.

SectionFooter.label: Section Footer
SectionFooter.helper: Optional note displayed below the activity cards. HTML is allowed and will be rendered as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Select a card to review the related feature.

Alerts.label: Alert Banners
Alerts.helper: Optional. Add one or more alerts. One saved alert is selected at random for each page render.

Content.label: Content
Content.helper: Required when this alert is used. HTML is allowed and will be rendered as entered.
Content.placeholder: A short message about an important website task or update.

Icon.label: Icon
Icon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building or fas fa-phone.

ActionLabel.label: Action Label
ActionLabel.helper: Optional. Short label for the alert action button.

ActionUrl.label: Action URL
ActionUrl.helper: Optional. Local and external URLs are supported. External links open in a new tab.
